paragraphs.text: Wurm is a creature type describing large limbless terrestrial reptiles , with the name derived from wyrm , describing mythical wingless dragons or serpents . These wurms have an endoskeleton, reptilian scales or plates, and a saurian head similar to a dragon 's. They may be aligned with any color of Magic , but most are wholly or partially green . Over the years and sets Magic Wurms have evolved into giant reptilian creatures that are more similar to Worms , characterized by eyeless faces and jawless mouths. Most wurms are forest dwellers. They are preternaturally hungry and relentless when pursuing their prey.

Dominarian Wurms trace their origin to the Elder Dragon War , during which the vastly powerful Elder Dragons that were defeated were stripped of their power, limbs, and wings, thereby becoming the land wurms .
Plane Shift describes Innistradi wurms as manifestations of green mana.
Wurms can be found on many planes. So far, Wurms are known from:

The sandwurms of Amonkhet have wider heads that are upside-down, with the eyes on the bottom. Their only known predator is the Chaos Maw , a hellion. After the Hekma was destroyed, sifter wurms destroyed Rhonas's Monument .

A craw wurm was summoned by the Kieryn Elves while fighting against the Calthyn Elves in the White Woods of Corondor . Also, corpses of four such wurms were found at the site of the last great battle of the Ironclaw Orcs . Scaled wurms flourished during the Ice Age . A very large scaled wurm known as Rhindle terrorized Kjeldor during the last few decades of the Ice Age. Their bodies are protected by scales—it was said that just one of their scales could be used as a roof for a human dwelling. The armored Johtull Wurms appeared during the Ice Age , commonly preying on southern Terisiare . One of them killed Zilgeth of Clan Ruby . Johtull Wurms are huge, but they are not very maneuverable; when attacked by a group of enemies, they can be defeated more easily. The art for Johtull Wurm was initially commissioned as an arctic variant of a Fungusaur .

Under the Nightmare spell of Ixidor , Phage 's unique constitution made it so that she regurgitated a swarm of beetles , which then became enormous wurms. These deathwurms were the embodiment of each of her murders. Ixidor sent Akroma to battle them but not even the angel was able to stop them. Ixidor was forced to use his unmen to escape, but some of them betrayed him and he was devoured. On the battlefield, Jeska saw that the wurms were wreaking untold havoc, and realized that she had to absorb them back in herself, even though that meant she would become Phage again.

On Eldraine , many wurms have adapted to life among the world's skyscraping beanstalks. These beanstalk wurms sport leafy growths, sustaining themselves on a mixture of natural photosynthesis and a carnivorous diet, and their stomachs are lined with thorns that aid in digesting prey eaten whole. The Giants of the Kingdom of Storms often use beanstalk wurms as a first line of defense against those who would ascend the massive beanstalks known as Everstalks to intrude on their realm. Beanstalk wurms lie coiled along the length of an Everstalk with their eyes closed and their stomach flattened against the stalk, appearing to be an enormous vine until an intruder attempts to climb them.

The greatwurms of the Edge are titanic creatures of great age and wisdom whose presence gives the Wurmwall in the Sothera system of its name. They have enormous lamprey-like mouths capable of chewing through asteroids.

Slagwurms are the largest type of wurms on Mirrodin . These creatures lived in the Tangle . They are known to dig huge tunnels. They compete for nesting ground around the Radix . Slagwurms all have large heads covered in natural armor plating; as a result, they have small, weak eyes. The people of Mirrodin made armor from slagwurm plating. The armor was tough, effective, cheap, and easy to make, as long as the armor of a slagwurm was on hand. During the Phyrexian invasion of Mirrodin , the Phyrexians compleated several types of wurms.

The wurms of Ravnica most often are found wreaking havoc in the Gruul wilds or have been trained by the Selesnyan Conclave. The Selesnya Guild uses wurms as living weapons; they cover the wurms' heads in giant metal plates, turning them into battering rams. Some Izzet enclaves make use of compost wurms to get rid of refuse.

Thunder Junction is home to rattlewurms, so named for the keratin rattles at the end of their tails. They are notable for their thick, gold-colored skin that resembles armor-plating. Obligate carnivores, they frequently menace the small settlements that have sprung up in the plane's deserts. They can burrow through the earth, emerging without warning, and carry venom that can cause excruciating pain. Unusually for reptiles, they care for their children after they are hatched, and families of rattlewurms seem to share one burrow.
